explanation: Water used in ceremonies to cleanse people from sin and impurity.
A rare, red-colored young cow without blemish or defect, sacrificed according to God's instructions.
The remains left after burning the red heifer, used to make purification water.
A state of ritual uncleanness resulting from contact with dead bodies or other unclean objects.
The duration of the cleansing process for a person who has become ritually unclean.
A plant used in cleansing rituals to sprinkle purification water on people and objects.
The dwellings of the Israelites during their journey through the wilderness, which could also become unclean through contact with dead bodies.
